title: Count the spanning trees of K4 by the Matrix-Tree theorem

source.citation: Szabolcs Horvát et al., IGraph/M: graph theory and network analysis for Mathematica, arXiv:2209.09145; IGSpanningTreeCount tests at szhorvat/IGraphM commit 8de23ab6b2dcab448ba13bffe4c3a864c54927e7

translation.notes: The source test expects sixteen spanning trees for K4. Noether builds the graph and applies the Matrix-Tree theorem through an exact determinant.
